description: This PHP source file defines a class 'FundamentalCompatibilityConstraintValidator' that validates the fundamental compatibility of CKEditor 5 with a given text format in Drupal. It checks for disallowed filters, HTML restrictions, creatability of tags, and matching of HTML restrictions to ensure CKEditor 5 plugins work correctly within the text format.

classes.name: FundamentalCompatibilityConstraintValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks the compatibility of CKEditor 5 with Drupal text formats, ensuring filters, HTML restrictions, and tag creatability align with CKEditor 5 plugin requirements.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the main validation process, checking no disallowed filters, HTML restrictions compatibility, tag creatability, and matching restrictions.

methods.name: checkNoMarkupFilters
methods.description: Ensures no disallowed TYPE_MARKUP_LANGUAGE filters are present, except for specific exempted filters.

methods.name: checkHtmlRestrictionsAreCompatible
methods.description: Verifies that the HTML tags allowed by the text format include all fundamental CKEditor 5 plugin tags.

methods.name: checkHtmlRestrictionsMatch
methods.description: Checks that the HTML restrictions of the text format match the output of enabled CKEditor 5 plugins.

methods.name: checkAllHtmlTagsAreCreatable
methods.description: Ensures all HTML tags supported by enabled CKEditor 5 plugins are actually creatable, considering plugin capabilities and restrictions.

methods.name: getFiltersInFormatOfType
methods.description: Static method to retrieve filters of a specific type from a text format, with optional extra requirements.

methods.name: findHtmlRestrictorFilterNotAllowingTags
methods.description: Finds a filter that restricts HTML tags in a way that excludes required tags, used for validation.
